issues.description: Some cell-type labels rely on protein epitopes rather than gene symbols (CD8, CD45RA, CD56, CD16); these were excluded because no unique gene symbol can be assigned from the paper.

Reference-label-transfer markers from Extended Data Fig. 3d (Ziegler et al.) were treated as context_only because they are external labels used for comparison, not the authors' own annotation markers.
Cluster inventory confirms 59 airway final labels = 25 epithelial + 34 immune, and 42 blood final labels = 34 initial + 8 IFN-stimulated states; no mismatch suggesting missing clusters.
